csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using Unity.Netcode; using Unity.Netcode.Components; using System.Linq; public class AutoSetupMultiplayerAll { public static string Run() { int count = 0; var roots = UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().GetRootGameObjects(); foreach (var root in roots) { foreach (var t in root.GetComponentsInChildren<Transform>(true)) { GameObject go = t.gameObject; if (go.isStatic) continue; string n = go.name.ToLower(); bool isDynamicProp = n.Contains("barrel") || n.Contains("thùng") || n.Contains("box") || n.Contains("obstacle") || n.Contains("chướng") || n.Contains("monster") || n.Contains("quái") || n.Contains("enemy") || go.GetComponent<Rigidbody>() != null; if (isDynamicProp) { bool added = false; if (go.GetComponent<NetworkObject>() == null) { go.AddComponent<NetworkObject>(); added = true; } if (go.GetComponent<NetworkTransform>() == null) { go.AddComponent<NetworkTransform>(); added = true; } if (added) count++; } } } if (count > 0) UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene()); return $"Added components to {count} dynamic objects (Rigidbody or specific names)."; } }
